minutes_text:
MINUTES

  ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MEETING

  JANUARY 30, 2018

An adjourned meeting of the City Council of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order at 6:30
p.m. in the City Manager’s Office, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by MAYOR HUFF.

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz and Zerunyan

City Council Members Absent:  Zuckerman

Others Present:  Pope and Romanelli, Park & Activities Commission
  Medawar and Yoo, Planning Commission

DISCUSSION REGARDING CITY COMMISSIONS

The City Council met first with the current and outgoing chairs of the Park and Activities
Commission then with the current and outgoing chars of the Planning Commission to discuss
the general operations of the commissions and identify any areas of concern. No action was
taken.

ADJOURNMENT

At 7:30 p.m., MAYOR HUFF formally adjourned the City Council meeting to a regular meeting
scheduled for Tuesday, February 13, 2018 beginning at 7:00 p.m.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Heidi Luce  Douglas R. Prichard
City Clerk  City Manager
